summary: Writes depth for geometry without drawing visible shaded color, useful for invisible occluders, depth masks, and Z-buffer control.

key_params.name: dodeform
key_params.note: Enable common MAT deform handling for skinned geometry

key_params.name: depthwriting
key_params.note: Write depth values to the depth buffer

key_params.name: cullface
key_params.note: Cull front, back, both, or neither face set

key_params.name: polygonoffset
key_params.note: Push depth slightly to avoid Z-fighting

key_concepts: Depth MAT is a depth-only material for creating invisible Z barriers, depth masks, and occluders without writing visible shaded color.
Depth testing decides whether a fragment passes against existing depth, while depth writing decides whether the passing fragment updates the depth buffer.
Cull Face settings are material to a depth-only occluder because culling one side can remove the expected barrier from that view direction.
Polygon depth offset is useful when an invisible depth surface is coplanar with visible geometry and would otherwise cause Z-fighting.
Deform settings still matter when the invisible depth object is skinned or driven by capture attributes.
common_gotchas: Depth MAT is intentionally invisible in color output; use it when the object should occlude, mask, or reserve depth.
Depth writing and depth testing are separate states; disabling either can defeat the occlusion purpose.
Cull face settings can make the depth barrier disappear from one side.
Use polygon depth offset carefully when coplanar geometry causes Z-fighting.
